hooks.name: DocMind — Start watchers on session open
hooks.description: Launches watcher.py app and watcher.py admin in new console windows every time a Kiro session starts. The watchers monitor all .py/.html/.css/.js files and restart the Flask servers automatically on change or crash.

action.command: cd /d "C:\Users\Yash\Desktop\Ultimate_Chatbot" && "C:\Users\Yash\Desktop\Ultimate_Chatbot\Yash\Scripts\python.exe" -c "import subprocess, sys; [subprocess.Popen(['C:\\Users\\Yash\\Desktop\\Ultimate_Chatbot\\Yash\\Scripts\\python.exe', 'watcher.py', m], cwd='C:\\Users\\Yash\\Desktop\\Ultimate_Chatbot', creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE) for m in ['app','admin']]"
